orderComplete: “So it burns again. Perhaps you ARE a Keeper.” — Cindra
“Hmph. The old court would have taken twice as long.” — Cindra
“Warmer already. Don't let it go to your head.” — Cindra
“The Flame remembers hands like yours.” — Cindra

early: It hums an old, old song.
near: The gold burns bright — she is almost awake!

finaleCindra: So the Elder wakes for YOU. Keeper… the Great Flame didn't die — it was TAKEN. Rest now. At dawn, we follow her past the southern ash.
finaleCindraProphecy: The old altar stirs, Keeper — finish my first request, and what sleeps there will wake for you. And the Great Flame? It didn't die. It was TAKEN.
goldenArrival: “The old altar ANSWERS you, Keeper. So the stories about that egg were true.” — Cindra
lateAwakening: At last — she waited for YOU, Keeper. The Elder rises, just as the stories promised.

hints.zeroWarmth: Out of Warmth? Rest by the fire — it returns on its own. The emberberry patch never needs any!
hints.boardFull: The board is crowded! Sell a spare piece, or deliver to Cindra's Ledger to make room.
hints.eggTrembles: Keeper — the egg! Look at the egg on the old altar, it's TREMBLING!

tasksComplete: “Every task, done. The Keep hasn't been this warm in an age… you've earned your rest, Keeper.” — Cindra
